subtitle: Cheap stack drains premium recovery and steals it
synopsis: FlashLite-RC-RISK forces GPT-5 Mini to burn every potion by turn 14, then survives its own final low-HP check and closes the fight at 13 HP. The upset works because the cheap stack manages volatility better, not because the premium model never fights back.

highlights.label: Premium model runs out of recovery
Last FlashLite heal keeps the upset alive
Cheap stack cashes out the upset
